title: This new $399 Sonos soundbar has me interested in fancy speakers for the first time - but it may be too much for most people (AMZN, AAPL, GOOGL)
text: This new $399 Sonos soundbar has me interested in fancy speakers for the first time — but it may be too much for most people (AMZN, AAPL, GOOGL) By Kaylee Fagan Jun 6, 2018, 5:04 pm 5 pts The Sonos Beam is the newest home theater soundbar to come on the smart speaker scene, and it's powered by Amazon's Alexa and, later, Apple's Siri.
